overview: GhostBusters is a FinOps decision-support system that analyzes Terraform pull-request and fixture-backed cloud inventory cases, gathers recorded evidence, evaluates deterministic safety policy, and requires human approval before remediation pull requests.
pr_reviews: PR Reviews show a selected Terraform review case, including the detected infrastructure change, evidence, confidence, recommendation, policy result, and human review controls.
cloud_hunt: Cloud Hunt scans controlled inventory fixtures for suspicious waste signals, separates likely ghost resources from protected resources, and creates review cases without changing cloud resources.
approvals: Approvals is the human review queue. Reviewers can inspect pending cases and use backend-controlled approval, rejection, evidence request, context, modification, or waiver workflows where allowed.
technical_audit: Technical Audit shows recorded run data: audit events, planning decisions, investigation questions, tool execution, evidence, conflicts, verifier checks, policy rules, retries, human history, and runtime metadata.
demo_mode: Demo Mode runs prepared scenarios with fixture evidence. It does not require live GitHub or cloud credentials and does not change repositories or infrastructure.
human_approval: Human approval is mandatory before GhostBusters creates a remediation pull request. Approval does not apply Terraform, merge pull requests, or directly modify cloud resources.
remediation_pr: A remediation pull request is either simulated for demos and Cloud Hunt or created through the configured GitHub integration after deterministic validation and human approval.
real_vs_fixture: Real GitHub cases are created from authenticated Terraform pull-request webhooks. Fixture-backed cases use prepared local evidence for demos and tests.
safety_boundaries: GhostBusters does not run terraform apply, merge pull requests, approve recommendations automatically, override policy, delete resources, resize resources, stop resources, or write to GitHub without the existing remediation service controls.
github_integration: The GitHub integration reads allowed pull-request metadata and changed Terraform files. It uses explicit repository allowlisting and webhook signature verification when enabled.
deterministic_fallback: If Gemini is disabled, unavailable, times out, or returns invalid data, GhostBusters continues with deterministic planning, evidence collection, verifier checks, policy evaluation, and human approval.
gemini_assistance: Gemini can optionally suggest investigation questions, explain recorded recommendations, or help answer read-only questions from supplied case data. It cannot make final safety decisions or execute actions.
